cover: UN: drones killed 306 in three weeks
Gunmen kill seven at church funeral
Tear gas and arson in Siang dam bandh

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Drones over homes and markets
bullets: The UN human rights office says drone strikes killed at least 306 people in the first three weeks of October.
It attributes the strikes to both the army and the RSF; they hit homes, markets, hospitals and displacement sites.
The Security Council condemned the Abyei market attack. Neither force's response was reported.

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Attack on a church funeral
bullets: Gunmen opened fire during a funeral at a church in Hmoud on Friday.
No one has claimed the attack.
Jordan's interior minister called it an 'unprecedented' terrorist attack; the search for the gunmen continues.

stories.label: India · Assembly · Land
stories.head: Tear gas at the Siang dam bandh
bullets: Police fired tear gas during Friday's 12-hour bandh against the Siang Upper dam project.
Protesters later reportedly set fire to an NHPC office, a police station and police vehicles.
Police say protesters threw stones and defied prohibitory orders.

stories.label: India · Assembly
stories.head: March stopped short of the EC
bullets: Police stopped a march against the revision of electoral rolls before it reached the Election Commission.
Outlook reports more than 100 detained; Scroll says several.
Police had asked marchers to leave; no official count was reported.
